== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Overseer (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]] (<code>1261_106</code>, Virtual Block 6 slip 110), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-110-Overseer.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-overseer-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Overseer (Virtual Block 6)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “May add Harc as a pilot. During battle, adds one destiny to total power. If opponent just deployed a Dark Jedi or Sith to a related site, may ▼ a related location. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 6 while at Bespin).”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1261_106</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number 110 as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-110-Overseer-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B10 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
